fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 50% match is a weak fit for this Go/Rust networking role, so upskill before applying.

**Strengths:**
- Ran Kotlin settlement service handling 40 million Kafka events daily
- Led 4 engineers through a 9-month monolith-to-6-services migration
- Cut payment API p99 latency from 480 ms to 120 ms

**Gaps:**
- No Go or Rust experience, both core requirements
- No Layer 3/4 networking, TLS, CDN or Linux networking background
- No Kubernetes, ClickHouse or Grafana experience

**Recommendation:** Build and publish a small Go or Rust networking project, such as a TCP proxy, before applying to show you can bridge the language and protocol gaps.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Cloudflare

Dear Hiring Manager,

Egress connectivity only works if it stays fast and available for every product built on top of it. I faced a version of that problem at Lumen Payments, where the payment status API had a p99 latency of 480 ms. I moved the hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis and brought it down to 120 ms.

That work sat alongside a settlement service I designed and ran in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka. I was on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents, so debugging production systems and owning their health is familiar ground, and your Run What You Build model suits how I already work. I also led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services, which meant running design discussions and code review that other engineers relied on. My background is in Kotlin, Java and Python rather than Go or Rust, and I haven't worked on Layer 3 and 4 networking. What I bring is 11 years of building event-processing services, API design, and the habit of learning a new stack quickly. I'm keen to apply that to the Egress platform behind WARP and iCloud Private Relay.

I'm returning to full-time engineering after a planned career break, and I'm available to talk through how my backend and on-call experience could help the Egress team.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - Egress (Go/Rust)
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Cloudflare Egress team,

You're looking for someone to own production-critical distributed systems and lead beyond their own code, and at Lumen Payments I designed and ran a settlement service on Kafka and led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. I bring 11 years of backend experience, including on-call duty and written post-incident reviews, though my production work has been in Kotlin and Java rather than Go or Rust. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I'm available for a conversation at your convenience and can start within a few weeks of an offer.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
